summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 new features: (1) Home 'À découvrir' section (discover-section) with 2 panels linking to /ai-studio and /voice-room, (2) Voice Room 'Partenaires engagés' block (voice-partners) with 4 cells, (3) PDF guide updated to 21 pages and still linked from admin. Admin CMS 'Voice Room — vidéos' tab exposes partners upload field, item headers now render '#1 — [Projet IA 01]' instead of '[object Object]', and Textes FR exposes the 'Bandeaux « À découvrir » (accueil)' block. Preview flow (localStorage op-preview-draft + ?preview=1) correctly renders partner logo + external link in new tab. FR→EN toggle updates discover text and partners label. Desktop (1440) shows discover side-by-side and partners 4 columns; mobile 390 shows discover stacked (flex-direction=column) and partners 2 columns. Zero page errors. No persisted admin changes (preview-only draft cleared after test).

home_discover.en_discover-1_text: Every voice deserves to be heard.

critical_code_review_comments: Discover panel click uses onClick={() => window.scrollTo(0,0)} and target page starts at top — works but React Router scroll restoration would be cleaner globally.
ArrayEditor template cloning uses blank(value[last]) — if last item has partially-filled nested object, user may expect blank; current behavior is correct (recursive blank). OK.
FieldEditor summary name derivation handles title/name/label as objects (fr/en) correctly, fixing the previous '[object Object]' in aiStudioMedia.works and voiceRoomMedia.capsules headers. Verified.
seed_data_creation: No persisted content. Transient localStorage 'op-preview-draft' was injected to validate partner logo preview on /voice-room?preview=1 and then removed. No admin PUT /api/admin/content call was performed, so no Versions restore needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three client requests verified. Home Discover (discover-section with discover-0 → /ai-studio and discover-1 → /voice-room), Voice Room Partners block (voice-partners with 4 cells, 2 cols at 390, 4 cols at desktop, FR/EN labels), 21-page PDF guide at /guide-admin-outsiders.pdf with AI Studio + Voice Room procedures (admin header admin-guide-link points to it), admin CMS summary headers fixed ('#1 — [Projet IA 01]'), Textes FR exposes 'Bandeaux « À découvrir » (accueil)', partners.0.logo upload button present. Preview flow uses localStorage key 'op-preview-draft' + ?preview=1 (same pattern as prev iteration).
